test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Pure
solution:
The correct answer is **"indecent"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pure** means not mixed with anything else.

 
 
• **Example:** *A **pure** Arab horse.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **indecent** means morally offensive.
 
 
• **Example:** *She accused him of making **indecent** suggestions to her.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate antonym of the given word **'pure' **is **'indecent.'**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the usage and meaning of the other options.
